E2901

Doctest output mismatch. Expected: `{expected}` Got: `{actual}`

What

Doctest output mismatch. Expected: `{expected}` Got: `{actual}`

Why

The example in the doc comment claims a different result from what the code produces. Docs cannot lie (D-TEST4/I5 generalized to user code).

Fix

Run `jet test --update-snapshots` to update the golden output, or fix the code to match the claimed output.
